description: Owners only (needs sign-in): Start here for any website request. Reads the business’s Latchbell-hosted website: pages, rev, preview_url (for the owner, good for an hour), whether it is published, page and browser checks, working (the designer is busy), interrupted, designer_chat and the photo library. Pass path for that page’s html. Prefer upload_site_pages when you can write the HTML (every step, from which business to a checked publish: https://latchbell.com/docs/website.md); site_designer_chat costs AI credits. Before writing a page that books, sells or takes reservations, read https://latchbell.com/docs/site-api, or it won't publish.
